ui_battleresultparam_hint_time: Maximum average battle time in timer ticks for S/A/B/C; lower is better. The game compares the sum of round times (each capped at 99) with each threshold multiplied by the round count. D is the fallback.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_life: Minimum average remaining HP (%) for S/A/B/C; higher is better. The game compares the truncated sum of round HP percentages with each threshold multiplied by the round count. D is the fallback.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_quality: Minimum average finish quality for S/A/B/C. One contribution is selected per round, summed, then compared with each threshold multiplied by the played-round count. The overall losing side receives D for TIME, LIFE and QUALITY.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_point: Points awarded for a TIME, LIFE or QUALITY rank, in S/A/B/C/D order. The three category scores are added to form the total score; ID_TOTAL determines its rank.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_total: Minimum total score for S/A/B/C after adding the TIME, LIFE and QUALITY points. Arcade applies its difficulty percentage to each category before summing. D is the fallback.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp: GP awarded by final battle rank S/A/B/C/D. All five slots are read. Tournament losses also use this table’s D slot.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp_team: Team Battle: Value 1 for a player-side team win; Value 5 otherwise. The caller compares recorded wins for sides 0 and 1. Values 2–4 are not read by this getter.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp_endless: Endless: Value 1 is added for each win; Value 5 is added when the run ends without a win. Values 2–4 are not read by this getter.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp_endless_up: Additional Endless GP: Value 1 × floor(win count / 10), awarded at the end of the run (from 10 wins). The stock caller always selects Value 1; no stock caller selects Value 5 of this row. A separate reward multiplier may apply.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp_tournament: GP for a tournament win, indexed by difficulty 0–4: tier 1 before the semifinal, tier 2 for the semifinal, tier 3 for the final. A loss uses ID_GP’s D slot. The fixed-difficulty tournament branch uses slot 0.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp_first_champ: First-champion bonus, indexed by tournament difficulty 0–4. This is a separate grant from the ordinary final-win reward.
ui_battleresultparam_hint_gp_arcade_diff: Percentage of each TIME/LIFE/QUALITY point award in Arcade, indexed by difficulty 0–4. Each category is multiplied and divided by 100 with integer truncation, then summed and ranked using ID_TOTAL. This changes score and rank, rather than directly multiplying GP.
ui_battleresultparam_unused_value_label: Slot {index} — not read by this consumer
ui_battleresultparam_time_threshold_hint: Maximum total time across rounds. An equal result also qualifies.
ui_battleresultparam_life_threshold_hint: Lower bound in HP percent per round. Equality qualifies; the comparison uses truncated sum(HP %) ≥ threshold × round count.
ui_battleresultparam_quality_threshold_h: Lower bound for average finish quality. Equality qualifies; sum(round contributions) ≥ threshold × played rounds.
ui_battleresultparam_score_threshold_hin: Minimum sum of TIME, LIFE and QUALITY points for this rank. Equality qualifies. ID_POINT assigns those points.
ui_battleresultparam_quality_bonus_hint: Signed quality contribution for this round finish. Only the first value is read by the result calculator.
ui_battleresultparam_arcade_rate_hint: Score percentage for this difficulty: 100 keeps points unchanged, 150 multiplies them by 1.5. Each component is truncated separately before calculating the total rank.
ui_battleresultparam_gp_reward_hint: GP payout slots. Ordinary GP is indexed by rank, tournament values by difficulty; TEAM/ENDLESS getters select slot 1 or 5 from a result flag.

ui_battleresultparam_check_life: Check whether the values are remaining-life percentages and whether the result screen uses S/A/B/C/D slots in this order.
ui_battleresultparam_check_rank: Check which rank each slot maps to on the result screen and whether Value 5 is unused or a D-rank fallback.
ui_battleresultparam_check_quality_bonus: Check which battle action triggers this quality bonus and whether only Value 1 is read by the game.
ui_battleresultparam_check_gp: Check the exact GP payout in the target mode and whether unused-looking zero slots are ignored.

param_unused_effect_argument_hint: Preserved in the file. The stock handler for this effect does not read this argument. Other effect IDs can use the same slot.
field_dlc_code_hint: Signed availability code at 0x1F8. Negative and class 3 entries are unavailable; class 2 is excluded from character selection. Codes 10000–10012 require the corresponding DLC entitlement; 20000–20009 use the content mapping table.
param_duel_fixed_hp_cap_hint: For type 2, sequences 9/10, the dispatcher replaces argument 3 with 100 before creating HP recovery effect 15. Editing this stored argument does not change its HP cap. Other arguments are preserved.

ui_battleresultparam_no_consumer_hint: No consumer for this row is established. The stored value is preserved.
ui_battleresultparam_arcade_threshold_hi: Minimum run score for this rank; equality qualifies. If no threshold matches, the Arcade getter returns S.
ui_battleresultparam_gp_slot_hint: Signed GP award for this rank, difficulty or result branch. Negative values deduct GP.
ui_battleresultparam_endless_up_slot_hin: Additional GP multiplied by the number of complete groups of 10 wins at the end of a run.

trophy_pc_aggregate_detail: The PC queue checks completion of the other registered achievements and then queues ID 00. It does not compare file value 45.
trophy_pc_counter_detail: After the gameplay condition is satisfied, a saved PC event counter is incremented. The executable compares it with 1. game_text_duplicate_crc: This CRC32 ID is already used by another message. Choose a unique ID.
game_text_invalid_hex: Enter a hexadecimal value from 00000000 to FFFFFFFF.
game_text_invalid_int: Enter a whole number from -32768 to 32767.
term_discard_changes: Discard unsaved changes and open another term list?
term_invalid_reference: {field} must contain ASCII text without null characters.
stage_bar_hint: Bar: current value. Light marker: value when this stage was opened. The scale adapts to both values.
stage_invalid_string: Enter non-empty ASCII text without null characters. Optional names may be empty.
stage_invalid_float: Enter a finite number using a decimal point.
stage_invalid_uint: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4294967295. Hex fields use digits 0–9 and A–F.
stage_outside_data: Choose an XFBIN inside the extracted data folder. You can also type its game path manually.
stage_invalid_hex: Enter the exact number of hexadecimal bytes. Spaces are allowed.
stage_paths_hint: Add a game path or select several extracted XFBIN files. Delete removes only that path; clumps stay intact.
stage_code_too_long: New or changed stage codes may contain up to 23 ASCII characters.
stage_rgba_hint: Colour in RRGGBBAA format. Click the swatch to choose a colour.
stage_colour_hint: Character lighting, shadows and fog. Choose a colour or enter RRGGBBAA.
stage_scalar_hint: Adjust the values and inspect the diagram or the map with Jonathan.
stage_unmapped_hint: These bytes include fields read by the native loader. Their effects are unresolved; unchanged bytes are preserved exactly.
stage_add_clump_hint: Choose a stage path and a clump from its XFBIN, or enter custom names. Each card has its own Duplicate and Delete actions.
stage_custom_clump_hint: Enter a custom clump name. The extracted XFBIN is unavailable at this path.
stage_clumps_from_file: Suggestions are clump names from this XFBIN. Custom names are also allowed.
stage_clumps_from_stage: Suggestions are clump names already recorded for this path in Stage Info. The resource file is unavailable.
stage_no_clumps: This XFBIN has no clump names in its chunk table. You can enter one manually.
stage_clump_read_error: Could not read clump names from this XFBIN. Manual entry is available.
stage_clump_unknown_hint: Additional scene setting. Keep its current value unless needed.
stage_delete_clump: Delete clump “{name}”? Its XFBIN path will remain in General.
stage_preview_lazy: The map loads when you select 3D preview.
stage_preview_missing: Map XFBIN not found. Load an extracted map file manually, or set the extracted game folder in Settings.
stage_preview_failed: Could not load map geometry. Choose another XFBIN; details are available in the tooltip.
stage_preview_no_geometry: This XFBIN contains no renderable map meshes.
stage_filter_effect_hint: The game colour filter: blue and red shifts set chroma; strength blends the result with the original image.
stage_runtime_override_hint: The file stores this value, but the game retains the current bloom/glare state instead when applying stage settings. Editing it does not change that inspected stage-application path.
stage_colour_unresolved_hint: The visual effect of this colour is unknown. Keep the original unless you have verified your change.
stage_character_light_hint: Character lighting. Alpha controls intensity, not transparency. Map materials use separate lighting.
stage_colour_tip_1: Ambient light on fighters in the normal state; alpha controls intensity.
stage_colour_tip_2: Ambient light on fighters in the alternate state; alpha controls intensity.
stage_colour_tip_3: Ambient light for the second character lighting group; alpha controls intensity.
stage_colour_tip_4: The effect of this colour has not been confirmed.
stage_colour_tip_5: Directional light on fighters in the normal state; alpha controls intensity.
stage_colour_tip_6: Directional light on fighters in the alternate state; alpha controls intensity.
stage_preview_shader_failed: Some materials could not be rendered.
stage_preview_limits: Original material shaders, cascaded shadows, glare, colour filter and antialiasing. The preview camera is independent. Colour 4 has no confirmed effect; the game overrides the stored glare values.
stage_shadow_direction_hint: Direction of character lighting and projected shadows. Both effects share this vector.
motion_animation_hint: Starts the opponent animation PL_ANM_<name> and sets its speed. Start and end frames refer to that animation, not the event timeline.
motion_face_hint: Changes the opponent’s facial animation and its starting frame.
motion_caption_hint: Shows the caption identified by Message ID for the authored duration. This command does not start voice playback.
motion_skip_hint: Changes animation frame skipping during the finish.
motion_bg_hint: Changes background drawing without moving stage objects.
motion_timeline_hint: Authored timing at 30 frames/s. Select or drag a marker; outlines show loaded positions. Caption bars show authored duration. Scene clocks and skip logic can change actual playback.
motion_frame_hint: Event frame on a 30-frame/s timeline. Events on the same frame run in list order.
motion_invalid_field: Check the highlighted value. Enter a complete number or a name of up to 31 Latin characters.
motion_unsaved: Save Situation Finish changes before opening another file?
motion_empty_stages: Add a stage to create its finish-event sequence.
motion_empty_events: Add an event to begin this sequence.
motion_limit_hint: The game processes only the first 256 events of this sequence. Later records are preserved but will not execute in this consumer.
motion_type_hint: Choose a command to edit its settings.
motion_custom_hint: The meaning of this command is not established here. Raw operands remain editable and all other bytes are preserved.
motion_name_hint: Resource name, up to 31 ASCII characters. Suggestions come from this file; manual input is available.
motion_duration_hint: Caption duration in frames at 30 frames/s.
motion_start_frame_hint: Animation start frame. For opponent body animation, 0 and 1 both start at the beginning; positive values use frame − 1.
motion_end_frame_hint: Animation end frame. Zero or a negative value leaves the end unrestricted.
motion_speed_hint: Animation speed multiplier. Zero pauses the animation.
motion_face_option_hint: A nonzero value invokes an additional face-animation update after setting its initial frame. Its complete visual effect is unresolved; the original integer is retained.
motion_bg_option_hint: Value 1 skips an additional stage-handle operation when hiding the background; other values enable it. The full effect of that operation is unresolved.
anmofs_finish_scope: Shared situation-finish offsets. The preview applies the receiver's local offset keys; finish animations, scene placement and camera are not reconstructed.
gdm_identity_hint: Link an arena hazard to a named Hit Reactions record. Type to search or enter a custom identifier.
gdm_stage_hint: Exact arena identifier. The first matching active row is used; duplicate arena IDs do not define separate hazards.
gdm_reaction_hint: Named reference into damageprm.bin.xfbin. Custom and missing names are retained; the game may fail to resolve them.
gdm_discard: Discard unsaved Gimmick Damage changes and open another file?
gdm_missing_reference: Hit Reactions was not found nearby. Choose damageprm.bin.xfbin to see named reactions and velocity calculations.
gdm_impact_hint: Damage and velocity multipliers passed to the attack. Compare edits with the last successful save.
gdm_damage_hint: Base attack damage, before receiver and battle modifiers. Stored as a float; no gameplay clamp has been established.
gdm_scale_hint: Multiplies the linked reaction’s base velocity. Zero removes that base contribution; 1 retains it. Negative and custom finite values remain editable.
gdm_velocity_limit: Compares the linked reaction’s movement values. The final trajectory also depends on direction and character state. “—” means no linked reaction is available.
gdm_secondary_hint: A nonzero kind sends five float arguments with the hit. Argument roles depend on the effect; their gameplay meaning is not yet confirmed.
gdm_effect_kind_hint: 0 skips creation of the additional packet. Other values are forwarded unchanged. Kind 1 occurs in the supplied Green Dolphin row; it is not a universal On switch.
gdm_effect_argument_hint: Parameter of the selected additional effect.
gdm_flags_hint: Ten slots build one 128-bit attack mask. Choose a bit index or leave a slot unused. Slots are combined, not played as a sequence; individual flag meanings remain unresolved.
gdm_flag_slot_hint: Choose a flag from 0 to 127. A negative value disables this slot.
gdm_contact_hint: Signed word copied to attack +380 and tested by receiver logic. Exact gameplay semantics and units are unresolved; this is not a confirmed timer.
gdm_hit_hint: Word copied to attack +30C; its low 16 bits also enter the reaction packet. Meaning remains unresolved. Keep the complete stored word.
gdm_invalid_number: Enter a valid 32-bit number. Float values must be finite; integers also accept 0x notation.
gdm_invalid_id: Identifiers must be ASCII without NUL characters.
gdm_invalid_flag: Choose a bit from 0 to 127, or use a negative value for an unused slot.
gdm_issue_inactive: Inactive reaction: select both a stage and a reaction.
gdm_issue_duplicate: Duplicate arena ID: the game uses the first matching active row.
gdm_issue_reaction: The reaction name is absent from the selected Hit Reactions file.
gdm_issue_long_id: The reaction identifier is too long for the game to use. Use fewer than 256 ASCII characters.
gdm_issue_flag_range: An existing flag index exceeds the supported maximum of 127.
gdm_issue_duplicate_flags: Repeated bit indices collapse to the same flag; slot order has no effect.
gdm_links_ready: Arena and reaction identifiers are present.
gdm_pending_invalid: Finish the highlighted input to update the comparison, switch rows or save.
info_snap_hint: Drag increment in authored UI coordinates. Manual input remains exact.
info_canvas_help: Click a region to select it. Drag its body or handles. Alt+click cycles overlaps. Wheel: zoom; middle drag: pan; Esc: cancel drag. Dashed: original geometry. Coordinates are authored UI units, not monitor pixels.
info_invalid: Correct these fields before continuing: {fields}. Numbers must be signed 32-bit integers; text must be valid XML.
info_type_hint: Choose a rectangle, circle or quadrilateral. Unsupported shapes cannot be selected by the game.
info_name_hint: Exact name used by scene code. Choose a name from this file or enter your own. Equal names identify a group; its record order matters.
info_scene_hint: Exact scene lookup name. Renaming it changes which game code can find this set.
info_geometry: Geometry used by the hit test
info_circle_geometry: Center ({x}, {y}) · radius {radius} · integer division toward zero
info_unknown_shape: This shape type is unsupported. Only its bounds are shown.
info_hint_x: Authored UI coordinate. X increases to the right. No game clamp has been established.
info_hint_y: Authored UI coordinate. Y increases downward. No game clamp has been established.
info_hint_w: Right edge is x+w. For circles, w/2 shifts the center; h alone defines the radius. Signed values are retained.
info_hint_h: Bottom edge is y+h. Circle center is (x+w/2, y+h/2), radius h/2, truncated toward zero.
info_hint_rtoX: Type 2 only: upper-right X = x+w+rtoX. This is a vertex offset, not padding.
info_hint_lboY: Type 2 only: lower-left Y = y+h+lboY. Inverted or crossed edges can reject every point.
cv_reference_help: Choose a name from the file or type a custom reference. Empty references are allowed; selecting a name never changes other fields.
cv_number_help: Enter an exact number or use the step buttons.
cv_pose_help: Pose references are grouped as Start → Loop → End. Suggestions include animation chunks in the selected viewer resource. This table contains no clip durations; it cannot supply an accurate playback timeline.
cv_assets_missing: Viewer resource unavailable. File references and custom input remain available. Set the extracted game folder in Settings, or open the table beside data/spc_viewer. Expected: {path}
cv_camera_help: Camera position and target in game units. Their on-screen direction also depends on camera rotation.
cv_lens_help: Limits the viewing angle, not the camera distance. The default angle is 45°. If the minimum exceeds the maximum, the maximum is used.
cv_probe_help: Compare the viewing angle with the opened file. This preview does not change the file.
cv_probe_slider_help: Explore the current minimum–maximum interval. Manual angle input stays available. Does not change the file.
cv_angle_unavailable: Cone available for angles between 0° and 180°
cv_unlock_help: Choose how the entry becomes available. DLC requirements are set separately.
cv_list_help: Enter resource names separated by commas.
cv_resource_138_help: Related model or scene resource name.
cv_invalid: Correct unfinished or invalid fields before saving, switching entries or changing the list: {fields}
cv_camera_offset: Camera relative to the look-at point
cv_camera_offset_help: The look-at point is the origin. Arrows compare camera − target in the local depth/height plane at one shared scale. Base translation and orbit are excluded; this is a coordinate diagram, not a rendered scene.
cv_offset_unavailable: Enter finite camera and look-at coordinates to compare
cv_menu1_index_help: The native loader groups consecutive rows with the same character group index. File order matters; these numbers are not used as a sort command. Custom and negative values are preserved.
cv_menu2_index_help: Stored per-entry model index. Native viewer initialization converts -1 to 0. Changing this index is not a command to reorder records in the file.
dictionary_category_hint: Include the article in this category. Each category can be selected independently.
dictionary_lookup_hint: Article ID used by rewards and other catalogs. Each article should have a unique ID.
dictionary_index_hint: Save slot, from 0 to 4095. Entries with the same slot share unlock progress.
dictionary_panel_hint: ASB panel reference. Suggestions come from this dictionary and the nearest extracted MainModeParam. Custom references remain editable; choosing one does not rewrite the panel rewards.
dictionary_unlock_hint: Choose how the article becomes available. DLC requirements are set separately.
dictionary_content_hint: Content requirement. Choose an existing value or enter your own.
dictionary_missing_id: The article needs an ID to appear in the game.
dictionary_duplicate_id: Another article uses this ID. Give each article a unique ID.
dictionary_duplicate_index: Duplicate save-state index: these articles share saved state.
dictionary_signed_index: This save slot cannot be used by the game.
dictionary_missing_panel: The panel reference is absent from the loaded ASB catalog.
dictionary_invalid_field: Check “{field}”: enter a whole number or a valid text reference. Your input has been kept.
dictionary_pending_input: Complete or correct the highlighted input to update the article diagnostics.
dictionary_panel_catalog_error: Could not read the local ASB panel catalog: {error}
dictionary_associated_character_hint: Associated character. Changing this reference has no confirmed effect on the article.
dictionary_shop_precheck_hint: Additional gallery-shop eligibility check. Its effect on dictionary articles is unconfirmed.
dictionary_gallery_price_hint: Shared gallery price. Zero or negative prices do not appear in the art shop.
dictionary_shared_message_hint: Optional text used by the shared gallery catalog.
dictionary_index_capacity: Save slot must be between 0 and {maximum}. An invalid slot can damage save data.
dictionary_character_catalog_error: Could not read the local character-code catalog: {error}
dictionary_no_free_index: All 4096 article save slots are occupied.
customize_character_hint: Search character codes and names from this file and the local characode table. Custom codes are preserved exactly.
customize_mode_hint: The game looks up the first record matching character and mode. Modes 0/1 are the two normal variants; mode 2 is the close-up. Other numbers are preserved without an assigned meaning.
customize_position_hint: Position in customization coordinates. The step buttons move by one unit.
customize_rotation_hint: Rotation in degrees. The step buttons change one degree.
customize_scale_hint: Uniform scale. The step buttons change the value by 0.01.
customize_diagram_caption: Drag the marker to edit X/Y. Parameter diagram.
customize_diagram_hint: Stored positions on equal axes (Y down); glyphs compare angle and relative scale. This diagram does not reproduce character artwork, bounds or the game viewport.
customize_drag_hint: Drag the current position marker to change X/Y. Esc cancels the drag. Exact values remain available above.
customize_missing_character: The character code is empty; no normal character lookup can match it.
customize_unknown_character: This character is absent from the local characode table. Check the custom character resources.
customize_duplicate_pair: This character and mode already have an entry. The first entry is used.
customize_missing_slots: Missing default views for this character: {slots}. Some setup paths require all three views.
customize_unknown_slot: This custom mode has no established consumer in the inspected paths.
customize_clamped: The game setup uses scale {value}; the stored value remains unchanged.
customize_invalid: Complete or correct these fields before saving or navigating: {fields}.
customize_nonfinite: The source contains a non-finite transform. Its original bytes are retained; a finite transform is required for the diagram.
customize_catalog_error: Character suggestions could not be loaded: {error}
customize_lookup_hint: The lookup matches character code and view mode in file order. Changes define defaults; existing saved customization may override them.
gallery_image_scope: Original resource pixels. Zoom with the wheel; drag to pan. This view does not simulate the gallery menu or unlock state.
gallery_no_issues: No catalog conflicts detected. Actual availability also depends on the game content and saved progress.
gallery_pending: Complete the highlighted input to update the preview and save.
gallery_invalid: Check “{field}”. Enter a valid number or resource name.
gallery_no_slots: All 256 gallery save slots are occupied.
gallery_empty_id: The gallery entry needs an ID to appear in the game.
gallery_duplicate: Duplicate {field}: the game may address a different record.
gallery_index_limit: Save slot is outside 0–{maximum}. This executable only initializes that range.
gallery_nonpositive_price: This shop type requires a strictly positive signed price to appear in the inspected shop list.
gallery_no_image: Select an illustration resource and texture name to inspect its pixels.
gallery_unsafe_path: Resource paths must stay inside the extracted data folder.
gallery_asset_too_large: This resource exceeds the image inspector limit (128 MiB per bundle, 16 megapixels per texture).
gallery_texture_missing: Texture “{name}” was not found uniquely in this resource. Choose a name from its catalog.
gallery_decode_failed: The existing texture decoder does not support this image.
gallery_resources_missing: Extracted resources were not found. Open a file inside a data tree or set the game-files folder in Settings.
gallery_hint_art_id: Gallery entry ID. Use a unique ID to avoid conflicts.
gallery_hint_chara_code: Associated characode reference. Choices come from this table and the local character catalog. Custom codes are retained.
gallery_hint_part: JoJo part/category. Known parts are named; custom signed 32-bit values remain editable.
gallery_hint_index: Persistent gallery save identity, not display order. This PC build initializes 256 slots (0–255). Existing custom values are retained.
gallery_hint_art_path: Path to the full illustration XFBIN in the extracted data tree. Selecting it does not modify the texture file.
gallery_hint_art_name: Exact named texture within the full illustration XFBIN. Suggestions update from the selected resource.
gallery_hint_icon_path: XFBIN containing the gallery thumbnail; a bundle can contain many named textures.
gallery_hint_icon_name: Exact thumbnail texture name. A matching filename alone does not identify a texture.
gallery_hint_art_string1: Message ID used as the gallery illustration title. Hover to read the local game text.
gallery_hint_art_string2: Message ID used as the shop description. Hover to read the local game text.
gallery_hint_unlock_cond: Choose how the illustration becomes available. Purchase, DLC and saved progress can add requirements.
gallery_hint_price: Signed 32-bit GP cost. Only positive prices pass the inspected art-shop price test. −1 is not a large unsigned cost.
gallery_hint_dlc_id: Content/DLC gate passed to the shared availability service. Suggestions are observed file values, not a complete enum.
gallery_hint_patch: Content version word passed to the shared availability service. File-backed suggestions do not impose a version limit.
gallery_hint_menu_index: Exactly 1 adds a preliminary eligibility call. The same eligibility check still runs unconditionally later. This is not menu order and disabling it does not bypass availability.
gallery_language_missing: No matching language resource was found for {path} (selected language, English or Japanese).
soundtest_text_scope: Text from your game resources. These Message IDs do not select audio cues.
soundtest_empty_id: The lookup ID is empty. Give this entry a unique Sound Test ID.
soundtest_negative_index: The game cannot use a negative save slot.
soundtest_custom_type: Custom categories other than voice lines appear in the music catalog.
soundtest_custom_flag: This option is enabled only when its value is 1.
soundtest_hint_bgm_id: Unique lookup name registered by the game. It is separate from the Message IDs and save slot.
soundtest_hint_entry_type: 1 selects the voice catalog; 0 and other values select BGM. Custom numeric values remain editable.
soundtest_hint_chara_code: Character associated with this entry. Suggestions come from this file and the local character catalog.
soundtest_hint_part: Signed part/category passed to the shared gallery decoder. Zero denotes no part / special entries in the supplied resources.
soundtest_hint_index: Save slot for this entry. Music and voice lines use separate sets of slots.
soundtest_hint_sound_str1: Localized name Message ID. The game hashes this string and resolves it through messageInfo.
soundtest_hint_sound_str2: Description Message ID for this sound entry.
soundtest_hint_unlock_cond: Choose how this sound becomes available. Purchase, DLC and saved progress can add requirements.
soundtest_hint_price: Price in GP. A positive price is needed to appear in the music shop.
soundtest_hint_dlc_id: Content gate copied by the common gallery decoder. Values are suggested from this file; no complete DLC enumeration is assumed.
soundtest_hint_patch: Version/content word copied by the common gallery decoder. Existing and custom values are retained.
soundtest_hint_menu_index: Exactly 1 runs the preliminary BGM shop eligibility check. Other values skip that check. This field is not menu order.
soundtest_hint_native_flag: Loader converts exactly 1 to true in runtime +38. Its complete consumer meaning is unconfirmed, so raw numeric input is retained.
soundtest_no_bgm_slots: All 128 music save slots are occupied.
soundtest_bgm_capacity: The game supports BGM slots from 0 to {maximum}. This slot is outside that range.
card_preview_scope: Original item artwork. Zoom and pan inspect the image without changing the file.
card_opaque_scope: These words remain editable. Their complete gameplay meaning is not established; upper words are preserved independently.
card_grants_speech: Extra speech ID intervals, victory then taunt: {values}
card_grants_sounds: Nonempty sound cues, in file order: {values}
card_no_issues: No problems found with this entry.
card_preview_unavailable: Image preview is unavailable for this entry.
card_no_slots: No unused card save identities remain in 1–2047. Existing cards were not renumbered.
card_empty_id: The card lookup ID is empty. Other tables cannot reliably refer to it.
card_index_limit: The save slot must be between 0 and {maximum}.
card_invalid_variant: The variant name must start with A–{last}.
card_unknown_category: Unknown item category. Check its contents before saving.
card_nonpositive_required: The required quantity should be positive; otherwise the item may already count as owned.
card_hint_card_id: Exact lookup identifier used by rewards and other tables. Renaming does not rewrite external references.
card_hint_index: Save slot, from 0 to 2047. Entries sharing a slot share unlock progress.
card_hint_medal_type: Item category. Choose the category that matches its contents.
card_hint_char_id: Exact character code. Suggestions come from this file and the local characode catalog. Changing it does not supply missing assets.
card_hint_letter: For categories 1–5 the game reads the first signed byte and subtracts A. Full custom text is retained. It is not a numeric interaction type.
card_hint_part: Part/category word passed to the shared content decoder; 0 is the uncategorized stock group.
card_hint_medal_name: Optional item name. Leave empty to use the category’s default name.
card_hint_card_detail: Localized description shown by customization. The preview resolves the exact Message ID from local game files.
card_hint_unlock_condition: Choose how this item becomes available. DLC and ownership requirements also apply.
card_hint_price: Signed 32-bit GP price. The adjacent upper word is independent. Exact entry is available; no guessed gameplay limit is imposed.
card_hint_unk18: The customization ownership check compares saved quantity against this signed value. It is not an enable checkbox.
card_hint_dlc_id: Content gate copied by the common decoder. Suggestions are values from the opened file, not a complete entitlement list.
card_hint_patch: Content-version word copied by the common decoder. File suggestions are not gameplay bounds.
card_hint_unk: The common decoder copies +6C to runtime +1AC. Its complete Custom Card consumer has not been established; retain custom values.
card_hint_operands: Taunts use +28/+2C; victory poses use +20/+24. Extra Speech uses +20/+28 as victory/taunt counts starting at ID 10. Other category-specific meanings remain unestablished.
card_hint_sounds: Category 5 returns the four nonempty cue names in file order. They are sound identifiers, not audio file paths.
title_text_scope: Resolved game messages. Text comes from your messageInfo files; references remain editable here.
title_preview_scope: Original background pixels. This view does not reproduce the complete player card layout or voice playback.
title_no_slots: No unused Player Title save slots remain (1–1023).
title_empty_id: The title lookup ID is empty. References cannot identify this entry reliably.
title_empty_text: No title Message ID is assigned.
title_index_limit: Save slot must be between 0 and {maximum}.
title_background_unavailable: No safe background resource is assigned. Enter an existing resource key to inspect it.
title_hint_title_id: Lookup key hashed by the game. Reward references use this ID; copying a title allocates a distinct key.
title_hint_anim_id: File +08, formerly Anim ID. The game builds playercard_bg_<key>.xfbin and the matching named resource from this key. It is not a skeletal animation.
title_hint_part: JoJo part or category for this title.
title_hint_chara_code: Character reference used for grouping titles and customization grants. Choose a known character or enter a custom code.
title_hint_dlc_id: Content gate passed to the shared availability system. Suggestions come from the file; zero alone does not prove that a title is unlocked.
title_hint_patch: Independent content-version word. No assumed patch range or automatic version conversion is applied.
title_hint_unlock_cond: Choose how the title becomes available. Other unlock requirements can also apply.
title_hint_unk2: Word +2C is copied by the common loader. A complete Player Title consumer is not established; it is not labelled as an enable checkbox.
title_hint_unk3: Signed 32-bit price word at +30, copied to the common runtime record. This does not establish that every title is sold at this price.
title_hint_unk4: Independent word +34 skipped by the inspected loader. Its gameplay meaning is unresolved; preserve it unless deliberately editing raw data.
title_hint_card_string1: Title Message ID at +38. The title UI reads its text/artwork, and voice helpers inspect its character/cue metadata. Edit the message itself in Game Text Editor.
title_hint_card_string2: Second Message ID at +40, hashed by the common decoder. Its complete Player Title consumer is unresolved. It is not a highlight texture or a direct audio-bank index.
title_hint_index: Title save slot, from 0 to 1023. New and duplicated entries use an available slot.
title_hint_part_padding: Independent upper word +14; the inspected loader consumes only +10 as the part. Preserved exactly.
title_hint_index_padding: Independent upper word +4C; native identity lookup uses only +48. Preserved exactly.
trophy_no_matches: No matching rows. Clear filters to show the catalog. The selected record remains open.
trophy_edit_hint: Edit the stored words. Their gameplay meaning has not been established.
trophy_storage_hint: Enter a whole number. The step buttons change it by one.
trophy_comparison_hint: Original values stay tied to this record, including after Save as. Differences describe file data; they do not predict unlocks or progress in the game.
trophy_restore_hint: Restore this record from the opened file. Other records are kept.
trophy_duplicate_hint: The first value also appears in other records. Repeated values are allowed and preserved.
trophy_no_original: Added in this session; no original values in the opened file.
trophy_invalid_hint: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4294967295: {fields}. Finish the input to save or switch records.
trophy_discard: Discard unsaved TrophyParam changes and open this file?
trophy_empty_hint: No achievements yet. Use New to add an entry.
netrank_search_hint: Search ranks by name, ID or points.
netrank_discard: Open another rank table and discard unsaved changes?
netrank_empty_hint: Add a rank to start building the point progression.
netrank_rank_id_hint: Rank ID used by related rank tables. A new ID needs matching game data.
netrank_required_points_hint: Minimum BP for this rank, including equality. Later matching rows take priority.
netrank_name_key_hint: Message ID for the rank name. Choose an existing reference or type your own. Text is read from local messageInfo files; edit the actual message in Game Text Editor.
netrank_probe_hint: Explore the thresholds in this file. The slider is a shortcut; manual input accepts every unsigned 32-bit point value. This does not change the document.
netrank_chart_hint: Point thresholds in original file order. Click a position to select its rank; exact edits use the fields above.
netrank_preview_scope: The point lookup follows the game's reverse-order, inclusive comparison. This checks rank selection only; match rewards, networking and player saves are outside this preview.
netrank_invalid: Check {field}: enter a complete unsigned 32-bit integer, or a Message ID without NUL characters.
netrank_pending: Finish the invalid field to update the progression. Save and navigation are blocked until the input is valid.
netrank_shadowed: This rank is unreachable: a later row qualifies for all of its point values.
netrank_duplicate: Another row returns the same rank ID. Rows are preserved in file order.
netrank_order_warning: This threshold does not exceed the previous one. Later rows take priority; inspect the reachable interval.
netrank_empty_name: The rank name is empty; no message can be resolved.
netrank_no_rank: No qualifying row · game fallback: ID 0, empty name
netrank_new_id_warning: This rank ID was absent from the opened file. Check compatibility with the game's other rank tables before using it in game.
netresult_search_hint: Search grade, BP difference, award or file row.
netresult_unused_hint: This threshold does not affect the selected grade calculation.
netresult_threshold_hint: Opponent BP minus winner BP. The first matching threshold is used; an equal value also matches.
netresult_amount_hint: BP added for the selected grade or score difference. A negative value subtracts BP.
netresult_probe_hint: Try a BP value from 0 to 9999999. This preview does not change the file.
netresult_grade_hint: S/A/B/C/D selects the corresponding one of the first five file rows. The battle judge supplies the winner’s total grade; this preview accepts it as input.
netresult_outcome_hint: A draw awards zero to both players. Otherwise the selected winner receives base + bonus and the opponent receives the converted negative third.
netresult_preview_scope: Compare BP changes with the opened file. This calculator does not change game progress.
netresult_chart_hint: Click a point to edit its bonus row. Lines compare stored awards in file order; the game selects one threshold row and does not interpolate.
netresult_invalid: {field}: enter a complete integer from {minimum} to {maximum}. Pending input is retained.
netresult_pending: Complete the highlighted field to update the calculation or save.
netresult_base_hint: File slot for grade {grade}. Its stored threshold is ignored by this consumer. The first five positions always mean S, A, B, C and D.
netresult_shadowed: This bonus row is unreachable: an earlier row matches its entire range.
netresult_interval: Used for opponent − winner BP from {low} to {high}, inclusive (signed i32 domain).
netresult_order_warning: This threshold must be below the previous one. The order of thresholds affects the result.
netresult_order_hint: Move the actual file row. Crossing the first five slots changes grade roles; later rows use first-match priority.
netresult_moved: Originally at file row {row}. Its current position determines its role and priority.
netresult_short_table: Calculation needs all five grade entries. Add the missing entries to enable it.
netresult_negative_warning: Negative or very large values can reverse the expected BP change. Check the result in the calculator.
netresult_probe_invalid: Enter BP from 0 to {maximum} for both players. Preview inputs do not change document data.
netresult_formula: Opponent − winner: {difference} BP; base {base}, bonus {bonus}; file row: {row}.
netresult_role_warning: This operation changes the first five file slots. Their positions always mean grades S/A/B/C/D; later rows become difference bonuses. Continue with this change of roles?
netresult_discard: Discard unsaved BP award changes and open this file?
om_group_overview_hint: Select a populated slot to edit it. The catalog reward is taken from slot 0 after all five missions clear. This is the file layout, not live completion progress.
om_reference_hint: Choose a reference from the document/resources or enter an exact ASCII value. Spaces and case are significant.
om_integer_hint: Enter a whole number or use the step buttons.
om_title_hint: Message ID for the visible mission text. Changing this text reference does not change the objective.
om_victory_hint: Only the stored value 1 requires victory. Other values allow either result; custom values are preserved.
om_count_hint: Required matches or event occurrences. Use 0–255; progress resets after 255.
om_filters_hint: All active filters must match. A recognized local fighter replaces the Part / roster check.
om_local_hint: Local player fighter code. A recognized nonzero character ID overrides Part / roster; an unrecognized code resolves to no explicit filter.
om_opponent_hint: Opponent fighter code. Empty/unrecognized character IDs remove this filter. There is no Part fallback or local-character exception here.
om_stage_hint: Select the required stage. Leave empty to allow any stage.
om_gp_hint: Signed GP change for this mission. Negative values subtract GP; the resulting balance is clamped to 0–99,999,999.
om_catalog_hint: Catalog reference for the group reward. Types 3, 6 and 8 use CustomCard lookup. Suggestions do not guarantee that every type/ID combination is usable in the live game.
om_banner_hint: Resource key in ui/online/LANG/online_mission_banner.xfbin. The first populated group slot supplies the banner; this is not an event condition.
om_event_probe_hint: Checks whether the event name matches this mission. It does not complete the mission or change progress.
om_invalid_field: Check “{field}”: enter a complete number or a valid resource name.
om_fix_fields: Complete or correct the highlighted mission fields first.
om_empty_slot: Empty slot · group reward cannot complete
om_missing_reward_slot: No slot 0: the group has no source for its catalog reward.
om_probe_empty: Enter an incoming string to test the selected mission.
om_probe_matches: Empty condition: qualifying match completion increments progress; ordinary events do not.
om_probe_runtime: The name matches. This mission also requires the correct character and magnetization state.
om_probe_yes: String gate matches. Other runtime requirements still apply.
om_probe_no: String gate does not match this input.
om_unverified_identity: Mission IDs outside 0–59 may be incompatible with game saves.
awb_subkey_unsupported: This HCA uses a nonzero AWB subkey. Standalone audition is unavailable; the subkey and encoded audio are preserved.
awb_loop_edit_hint: Exact audible-sample positions, after encoder delay. Drag the two markers at the top of the waveform or enter sample numbers. Esc cancels a marker drag. ACB cue commands may override looping in game.
awb_loop_edit_invalid: Enter integer positions with 0 ≤ start < end ≤ {total}. The unfinished input is preserved.
awb_loop_none: No loop stored in this HCA stream.
awb_waveform_hint: Click or drag to seek. Mouse wheel zooms around the playhead. Arrow keys move the cursor; Home/End jump to the edges. Time ruler: seconds.
awb_waveform_empty: Load the waveform to inspect this stream.
awb_preview_scope: Preview the audio without game effects or mixing.
awb_source_hint: Choose the edited or original audio for preview.
awb_loop_hint: Preview-only repeat between stored HCA loop points. Does not change HCA data or ACB cue commands.
awb_loop_invalid: Stored HCA loop is outside the stream: {start}–{end} s. Loop audition is unavailable; data is preserved.
awb_gain_hint: 1 keeps the original volume; 0 is silent. The step buttons change it by 0.05. The game’s mixer can change the final volume further.
awb_gain_invalid: Enter a finite number greater than or equal to zero.
awb_restore_hint: Restore all encoded audio bytes for this stream from the opened bank. Other streams remain unchanged.
awb_pcm_stats: Decoded PCM: {channels} ch · {rate} Hz · peak {peak}% · {clipped} samples at full scale
texture_channel_hint: Inspect stored colour or alpha. Channel selection does not edit the texture.
texture_comparison_hint: The reference is the file as opened, including after Save and Undo. New textures have no reference. Different sizes align at the top left.
texture_mip_hint: Inspect the actual stored mip levels. Lower levels change only after applying edits. Undecodable levels are reported, never synthesized.
texture_preview_scope: Source pixels. Materials, lighting and UV mapping belong to the game scene.
texture_unavailable_level: This stored mip level could not be decoded. Its original bytes are retained.
texture_rebuild_hint: Preserve the existing level count, limited by the new dimensions. Levels are rebuilt with Lanczos. Turn off to keep only mip 0. This is an authoring operation, not game sampling.
texture_edit_impact: Saving or selecting another texture applies the image adjustments. Transparency is preserved.
texture_adjust_brightness: Brightness: 0 is unchanged; −100 is black, +100 doubles RGB. Alpha is unchanged.
texture_adjust_contrast: Contrast: −100 gives a flat mean tone, 0 is unchanged, +100 doubles contrast.
texture_adjust_sharpness: Sharpness: −100 blurs, 0 is unchanged, +100 sharpens by a factor of 2.
texture_adjust_hue: Hue in degrees. Normally a relative shift; Colorize uses an absolute hue (value + 180°).
texture_adjust_saturation: Saturation: relative factor 1 + value/100. In Colorize, saturation is 0.5 + value/200.
texture_adjust_lightness: HSV value offset in percentage points, clamped to 0…100%. Alpha is unchanged.
texture_name_conflict: A texture with this name and path already exists.
texture_invalid_name: Texture name must not be empty or contain NUL.
texture_unsaved_open: Save texture changes before opening another file?
texture_invalid_color: Enter six hexadecimal colour digits, for example #A15CC8. The unfinished input is preserved.
font_search_hint: Search by character, U+ code, decimal code, icon tag or resource
font_metadata_hint: Stored font names. Changing these names does not redraw the atlas or select a Windows font.
font_rect_hint: Glyph rectangle in atlas pixels. Empty rectangles are allowed.
font_atlas_hint: Click a glyph to select it. Wheel to zoom; Fit and 1:1 inspect source pixels. The outline shows the current rectangle.
font_author_hint: Preview of Windows font rasterization into the existing rectangle. Apply writes pixels only; character code and spacing stay unchanged. DXT5 recompresses intersecting 4×4 blocks and may affect neighboring pixels. The current preview shows the decoded saved result.
font_icon_hint: Choose the icon image and adjust its crop and drawing settings.
font_icon_float_hint: Enter an exact value or change it in steps of 0.1.
font_raw_hint: Expert byte editing. Apply structured fields or hex separately; conflicting changes and incomplete input block saving and navigation.
font_metadata_error: Font names must contain fewer than 32 ASCII bytes and no NUL.
font_tint_hint: Choose whether the icon follows the surrounding text color.
font_restriction_hint: Nonzero permits this icon when an additional font drawing restriction is active. The purpose of that font state is not established.
font_icon_preview_hint: Exact source crop from the selected local resource variant. This view does not reproduce menu layout, text tint, scaling or platform selection in the running game.
font_no_records: This font file contains no records.
font_no_bitmap: This glyph has no bitmap, or its source pixels cannot be decoded.
font_advance_hint: Distance to the next glyph, in pixels before font scaling.
model_no_geometry: This XFBIN has no readable model geometry.
model_render_failed: Rendering failed. Details are available in the tooltip.
model_original_hint: Show the opened model with the same camera and animation frame. Preview only; edits remain in the document.
model_exact_hint: Enter an exact value or use the 0.1 step buttons.
model_position_hint: Local position relative to the parent bone, in model units. The viewport shows the resulting hierarchy.
model_rotation_hint: Local Euler rotation in degrees, X → Y → Z.
model_scale_hint: Local scale multiplier. 1 preserves the authored size.
model_alpha_hint: Alpha reference divided by 255. This controls the cutoff, not overall opacity.
model_glare_hint: Material glare coefficient. Its effect depends on the shader and scene postprocessing.
model_native_material_hint: Original material program and authored texture slots. Component meanings vary by shader.
model_dynamics_hint: Stored dynamics coefficients. A game-accurate cloth/physics simulation is not established.
model_unknown_hint: Unresolved fields retain their stored values. No speculative behavior is simulated.
model_invalid_coordinate: This bone is not in the model’s clump.
model_material_layout_mismatch: Material format and coefficient count do not match. Restore the format before saving.
model_model_layout_mismatch: The optional model flag requires a different coefficient layout. Restore the flag before saving.
model_uv_hint: UV offset and UV scale. A scale of 1 preserves the texture.
model_navigation_hint:
Drag left: orbit · Drag right: pan · Wheel: zoom
Click: select model · Ctrl+click: select material
model_color_hint: The picker edits RGBA in 0…1. Values outside this interval retain exact manual input.
model_force_culling_hint: Force back-face culling for inspection. When disabled, each material uses its authored culling mode.
model_lighting_hint: Lighting and color processing from the selected StageInfo arena. Preview settings do not change the model file.
xfa_name_hint: Sound name, up to 253 Latin characters. Linked cue names must be updated separately.
xfa_properties_hint: 0 dB keeps the volume; one semitone equals 100 cents.
xfa_exact_hint: Enter an exact value or use the step buttons.
xfa_invalid_properties: Finish the highlighted value before changing sounds or saving.
xfa_properties_applied: Tone processing applied. Unedited fields remain exact.
xfa_stream_loop_hint: Loop bounds are samples per channel; the end is exclusive. A loop needs at least two samples. After applying, drag the top waveform markers to adjust it.
xfa_loop_applied: Stream loop applied without re-encoding audio.
xfa_import_hint: Import audio into this bank. Existing sound links stay unchanged.
xfa_restore_tone: Restore this tone from opened file
xfa_no_template: A source sound is needed before adding audio to this bank.
xfa_delete_hint: Delete "{name}"? Its slot becomes empty so other tone indices remain stable. Existing cues that point to this sound will be silent.
xfa_native_hint: Sound filters, spatial settings and routing.
xfa_loop_none: No loop stored in this audio stream.
xfa_empty_bank: This bank has no sounds. Use New or Import audio files to add one.
number_slider_span: Drag range: {minimum} to {maximum}. Exact entry also accepts values outside this range.
xfa_play_decoded_hint: Play the decoded stream. Game mixing and effects are not included.
xfa_select_loop_hint: Choose two points or drag across the waveform to set a loop.
xfa_loop_first_point: Select the first loop point on the waveform. Esc cancels.
xfa_loop_second_point: Select the second loop point, or finish dragging. Esc cancels.
usm_preview_scope: Playback of the selected video. The encoded result is decoded from the actual USM; display uses a compressed preview up to 1280 px. This does not simulate game triggers or overlays.
usm_empty_preview: Open a USM movie to view it and prepare a replacement.
usm_monitor_hint: Listening volume only; the saved movie is unchanged.
usm_import_instruction: Import a video, choose the framing and audio, then prepare the USM result.
usm_open_instruction: The original movie sets the output resolution, frame rate and codecs.
usm_fit_hint: Fit preserves the whole image; Fill crops the edges; Stretch changes the image proportions. Output size comes from the original USM.
usm_audio_hint: Imported audio follows the selected interval. Original audio starts at movie time zero. Short audio is padded with silence; video is never cut to audio length. Channels and sample rate follow the original when available.
usm_build_hint: Prepare the encoded movie to inspect the actual framing, timing and audio. Save also prepares it when needed.
usm_preview_failed: Preview was not prepared. You can retry; imported settings and validated USM remain available.
usm_replacement_ready: Validated USM is ready to preview and save.
usm_error_no_video: No readable video stream was found.
usm_error_container: This is not a valid CRI USM container. No destination was changed.
usm_error_trim: Choose an end after the start, within the imported video duration.
usm_error_tracks: Replacing multi-video or multi-audio USM is not supported. The original can still be viewed, exported or copied without changes.
usm_error_codec: Replacement requires a supported original codec: Sofdec Prime/MPEG or H.264 video with ADX/HCA audio. The original remains available for viewing and export.
usm_error_timing: Could not determine video duration or frame rate. Encoding is disabled to avoid guessing.
usm_error_aspect: Replacement of non-square-pixel USM is not supported; the original is preserved.
usm_error_output_profile: The encoded result does not match the original video profile or selected duration. It was not saved.
usm_error_output_audio: The encoded audio track is missing or does not match the requested format. The result was not saved.
usm_error_disk: Not enough temporary disk space. Raw video requires about {gib} GiB; choose a shorter interval or free disk space.
usm_error_export_source: Choose an export path different from the source videos.
usm_timeline_hint: Seek on the ruler. In Imported video, drag the clip edges to trim or drag its body to move the interval. Escape cancels a drag. Left/Right seek one frame; Home/End seek to the ends.
usm_empty_timeline: The movie timeline appears after opening a video.
usm_process_timeout: Reading media information took too long. The process was stopped.
usm_error_audio_source: The selected source has no audio track. Choose another source or remove audio explicitly.
effect_search_hint: Search effect names, resource paths, slot IDs (decimal or hex), handlers and file rows.
effect_empty_catalog: The catalog is empty. Create a binding with New.
effect_slot_hint: Effect binding ID, from 0 to {maximum}. Use a unique ID for each binding.
effect_handler_hint: Choose how the effect is created. An unsupported handler can prevent it from loading.
effect_string_hint: Exact ASCII resource reference, up to {maximum} bytes plus NUL. Search existing choices or enter a custom value. Names are case-sensitive; whitespace is retained.
effect_inspection_scope: Inspection reads the original XFBIN chunk names and types. This table contains no positions, colors or timing; particle rendering and battle behavior are not simulated. Damage Effects links cover only the companion damageeff table.
effect_invalid_number: {field}: enter a complete integer from 0 to 4294967295 (decimal or 0x hex). The pending text has not been applied.
effect_invalid_string: {field}: use ASCII without NUL, up to {maximum} bytes. The pending text has not been applied.
effect_slot_unsafe: The binding ID must be between 0 and {maximum}; other values can prevent loading.
effect_factory_unsafe: Unknown effect handler. Choose a supported handler to avoid loading errors.
effect_duplicate_effective: Repeated ID: this is the last definition in file order and takes precedence.
effect_duplicate_shadowed: Repeated ID: a later definition overrides this binding.
effect_incomplete_binding: This handler has an empty file or effect name. Choose both parts of the resource link.
effect_legacy_layout: This catalog uses a different name format. Check that it belongs to your game version.
effect_reference_error: Damage Effects reference could not be read: {error}
effect_references_unavailable: Companion damageeff table not found; usage elsewhere is not checked.
effect_no_references: No references in the companion damageeff table. Other game commands may still use this ID.
effect_resource_invalid: Resource inspection is paused until the pending input is valid.
effect_root_missing: Choose the extracted data folder to resolve resource links.
effect_name_missing: Name not found in this XFBIN: {name}
effect_asset_outside_root: Choose a file inside the selected data folder, or change Resources folder first.
effect_slots_full: All available effect binding slots are occupied.
effect_delete_warning: Delete the definition for ID {slot}? Remaining IDs stay unchanged. Commands using this ID may lose their binding; if it is repeated, an earlier definition may become active.
effect_discard: Discard unsaved effect binding changes and open another file?
effect_no_creator: Handler 0 has no creator: this binding does not construct an effect.
soundparam_empty_section: This section is empty. Add a record to begin.
soundparam_resources_missing: The extracted sound folder is unavailable. Resource names remain editable.
soundparam_no_resource_reference: This record has no direct file reference to inspect.
soundparam_ordinal_warning: Indices are positions in the file. Deletion shifts subsequent records; external references are not automatically rewritten.
soundparam_delete_warning: Delete this sound record? Subsequent indices will shift. Existing character and external game references will not be remapped.
soundparam_bad_relation: {field}: {value} does not resolve to a character row in the reference lookup.
soundparam_truncation: {field}: the game uses the whole-number value {value}.
soundparam_duplicate_name: The same name occurs in another record. Indices remain distinct.
soundparam_scope_sndcmnparam: Named sounds in file order. This table stores references, not waveforms or timing.
soundparam_scope_pldata: Character sound references and related rows. File-name inspection lists actual extracted files; it does not simulate game playback.
soundparam_scope_cridata: Choose the sound banks used by this resource.
soundparam_hint_audio_id: A fixed ASCII sound name, up to 31 bytes plus NUL. Its ordinal is used by game-side lookup.
soundparam_hint_char_id: Character resource code. The reference engine builds voice, event and lip-sync paths from this code. Up to 31 ASCII bytes.
soundparam_hint_spl: First special-bank name (+60), selected by a separate runtime slot. Up to 31 ASCII bytes.
soundparam_hint_spl_interaction: Second special-bank name (+80). Both special references are stored independently.
soundparam_hint_ev: Event-data reference. Up to 31 ASCII characters.
soundparam_hint_stand_index: Related character entry. Use -1 to leave it unassigned.
soundparam_hint_unk2: Second related character entry. Use -1 to leave it unassigned.
soundparam_hint_unk3: Third related character entry. Use -1 to leave it unassigned.
soundparam_hint_entity: Additional routing option for this sound bank.
soundparam_hint_char_index: Character slot used when loading this sound bank.
soundparam_hint_str0: One complete 64-byte field, up to 63 ASCII bytes plus NUL. Stock examples include ASB.acf and BGM.acb.
soundparam_hint_str2: One complete 64-byte companion name. Stock examples include BGM.awb. The old editor incorrectly split it into two fields.
soundparam_hint_float3: Default sound slot when no override is selected.
soundparam_hint_flag: Unsigned 16-bit value passed with the additional resource. Independent bit meanings are unconfirmed; enter decimal or 0x hexadecimal.
acf_no_matches: No matching ACF records. Clear search to see this section.
acf_delete_references: Deleting a record can change links to later records. Check the linked categories, buses and effects after deletion.
acf_unsupported_dsp: This effect payload or renderer is not decoded. Changing the effect type does not convert its bytes. Raw data remains editable.
acf_route_hint: Select a bus, effect or send to edit it.
acf_invalid_text: {field}: text must be valid UTF-8 and cannot contain a NUL character.
acf_non_volume_level: ParameterId is not 0. This value is passed to the selected native parameter; volume units and audible behavior are not assumed.
acf_effect_unavailable: Editing is not available for this effect. Its settings will be kept when saving.
acf_command_unavailable: Editing is not available for this command. Its settings will be kept when saving.
acf_user_invalid_links: Some links or sound limits are invalid. Check the selected categories, buses, effects and concurrent sound limits.
acf_user_react_flow:
{source} → {dest}
{attack} ms to level {level} → {hold} → {release} ms to the original level
acf_user_source_category: Sounds in this category trigger the volume change.
acf_user_duck_attack: Time to reach the target level, in milliseconds.
acf_user_duck_release: Time to return to the original level, in milliseconds.
acf_user_duck_level: Target volume: 0 is silent; 1 keeps the original level.
acf_user_volume: Bus volume: 0 is silent; 1 keeps the original level.
acf_user_send_level: Send volume: 0 is silent; 1 keeps the original level.
acf_user_pan_volume: Volume of the spatial audio path.
acf_user_max_voices: Maximum number of voices playing at the same time.
acf_user_default_value: Value used before a variable is changed.
acf_user_hold_type: Hold until the trigger sounds end, or for a fixed duration after the volume transition.
acf_user_hold_time: Duration used when a fixed hold is selected, in milliseconds.
acf_user_paused_cues: Choose whether paused sounds keep the rule active.
acf_user_fx_start: First effect in the bus effect chain.
acf_user_fx_count: Number of consecutive effects in the chain.
acf_user_link_start: First send assigned to this bus.
acf_user_link_count: Number of consecutive sends assigned to this bus.
acf_user_command_index: Sound-limit rule used by this category.
acf_user_cue_lists: Number of groups that can have independent concurrent sound limits.
acf_user_cue_nodes: Shared capacity for concurrent sound limits. Increasing a limit may require more capacity.
acf_user_bypass: Choose whether the effect processes sound or is bypassed.
acf_user_cue_limit: Maximum sounds playing at once. Zero disables this limit.
acf_user_cue_work_index: Rules with the same group share a concurrent sound limit.
acf_user_cue_policy: Sound selection mode for this limit.
field_unconfirmed_hint: The effect of this setting is unconfirmed.
